changelog: **Neutral default brand for an unbound marketing host; no tenant data in the code (#2939).** The MARKETING vertical's built-in brand is now the neutral *coreCRM*: the product blue (`defaultAccentFor`, `themeColorFor`, `mailAccentFor` return the product default in every vertical) and a new static icon set — `public/icon-core.svg` (a lucide trend line on a slate `#1e293b` tile) plus the `-core` PNG, shortcut and 17 splash images cut by `scripts/generate-pwa-images.ts` — used only where a host has no organization brand. `BrandMark`/`BrandTile` render that glyph (`[data-default-mark]`). The tenant-specific mark component, its icon/splash files, its splash variant and generator entry are gone. The `magenta` accent key stays (people have it saved) on Tailwind's fuchsia ramp (600 = `#c026d3`). `src/lib/marketingPlans.ts` keeps only the plan keys: without an org `marketingPriceList`, `/pricing` shows a neutral "pricing on request" block (`pricing-marketing-on-request`, demo CTA) and the landing FAQ answers with `faqMarketing5AOnRequest` — no figure in code (`resolvePriceList` → `{ source: 'none' | 'invalid', list: null }`). The MARKETING fallback postal letter is a short generic German text about "unser Produkt". Extra `external_id` import header spellings are org data: the `importExternalIdAliases` setting (comma/newline list, `parseHeaderAliases()`, default none; written through `PUT /api/admin/settings`, sales verticals only). The marketing demo seed's org is named "Acme Sales Demo (Marketing)" on create. Turkish copy around `{product}` no longer glues a case suffix to the name. Tests assert the neutral default on an unbound host and the database brand on a host bound to a synthetic organization (`e2e/helpers/brand.ts`); the marketing tour screenshots were recaptured. The forbidden-terms tree scan is now blocking.

en: A marketing site that has not set up its own brand now shows a neutral look — the coreCRM name, the standard blue and a simple app icon — and its pricing page invites you to ask for an offer instead of listing figures.
tr: Kendi markasını henüz tanımlamamış bir pazarlama sitesi artık sade bir görünüm sunuyor — coreCRM adı, standart mavi ve basit bir uygulama simgesi — ve fiyat sayfası rakam listelemek yerine teklif istemeye davet ediyor.
de: Eine Marketing-Seite ohne eigenes Branding zeigt jetzt ein neutrales Erscheinungsbild — den Namen coreCRM, das Standardblau und ein schlichtes App-Symbol — und die Preisseite lädt dazu ein, ein Angebot anzufragen, statt Zahlen aufzulisten.
